nodes.summary: The first-order language of frames: no function symbols, one binary relation `R`.
nodes.title: First-order language of Kripke frames

nodes.summary: The relation symbols of the first-order frame language, indexed by arity: a single binary symbol $R$ for accessibility, and no symbols of any other arity.
nodes.title: Relation symbols of the frame language

nodes.summary: A binary relation $r$ on a set $W$ (a bare Kripke frame) makes $W$ a structure for the frame language, in which the accessibility symbol $R$ is interpreted as $r$: $R(w, w')$ holds if and only if $r(w, w')$.
nodes.title: A frame as a first-order structure

nodes.summary: A Kripke model $M$ with set of worlds $W$ makes $W$ a structure for the modal language: the accessibility symbol $R$ is interpreted as the accessibility relation of $M$, and the predicate $P_a$ for an atom $a$ holds at exactly the worlds where $a$ is true under the valuation of $M$.
nodes.title: A Kripke model as a first-order structure

nodes.summary: For a set of atoms, the first-order language of modal logic has no function symbols; its relation symbols are a binary symbol $R$ (accessibility) and a unary symbol $P_a$ for each atom $a$.
nodes.title: The first-order modal language

nodes.summary: Relation symbols of the modal first-order language: accessibility `R` (binary) and a unary predicate `P_a` for each atom `a`.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
